title: With the app open, a rest can end with no bell, no buzz and no pop-up if the app was busy for a moment
what: When a rest ends with the app on screen, the app rings its own bell only if its countdown wakes up within one and a half seconds of the end. If it wakes later, the app assumes the phone pop-up already rang. But with the app on screen the phone pop-up for the rest is held back on purpose. So if the app was busy at that moment, nothing rings at all. Phones where the alert rings by itself are safe; this hits phones where the app's own bell is the only sound, such as a member who turned app notifications off.
expected: A rest that ends while the app is open always gives the bell or the buzz once, even if the app was a little slow to notice.
fix_line: When the app is open and the rest end is noticed late, still buzz and ring once instead of assuming the pop-up did it

items.reason: rest bell, record chime and open-on-watch go only to the member's own phone and are decided by phone settings; no gym row decides who gets them and field-fill has no field for them
